messages:
maria.prod: FYI I've published the RCA for the 08/14 routing incident: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1898765432-routing-incident-rca. TL;DR: a bad traffic-routing rule + metric mislabeling caused autoscaler to underprovision for ~24m; impact: elevated p95 and several timed-out requests. No customer data loss.
maria.prod: I put a 3-line exec summary at the top and an "Immediate Action" checklist at the bottom. Please review and pick owners.
postmortem-bot: New document created by maria.prod: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1898765432-routing-incident-rca (snapshot) :robot_face:

jess.ops: Thanks Maria. Can we include the exact routing rule id and the deploy that introduced it? that helps compliance.
maria.prod: yup, added rule id `route-42` and deploy tag `deploy-2026-08-14-7f2`. Also included the deploy diff in Appendix C.
ravi.eng: I'll take the autoscaler metric-label fix and add a unit+integration test to catch label drift. PR will be up by EOD.
tony.sre: I can own the alerting changes + runbook updates. Plan: add an alert for mismatch between route traffic and node allocations and widen the aggregation to 40s. Will file PR tomorrow morning.
support-team: I'll draft the customer outreach for the small set of affected tenants and post the template here for review. ETA tomorrow 9am PT.

maria.prod: Immediate action items (copied here):
1) Fix routing rule and add deploy-proof checks  owner: @ravi.eng  due: today 18:00 PT
2) Autoscaler metric-label fix + tests  owner: @ravi.eng  due: tomorrow COB
3) Alert + runbook update (add route-vs-node alert, widen window)  owner: @tony.sre  due: tomorrow 11:00 PT
4) Customer outreach draft + review  owner: @support-team  due: tomorrow 09:00 PT
5) Add a CI gate that validates routing rules against known-safe patterns  owner: @jess.ops  due: Fri 12:00 PT

maria.prod: Also proposing a 30-min follow-up checkpoint next Tue to close items and decide on permanent mitigations. Options: Tue 08:30 PT or Tue 15:00 PT. React with :thumbsup: for preferred slot.

tony.sre: +1 08:30 PT for me (earlier the better).
ravi.eng: 15:00 PT works better (need morning to finish tests).
jess.ops: 15:00 PT preferred.
support-team: either works.

maria.prod: OK locking Tue 15:00 PT. Calendar invite will be sent. Agenda: quick RCA recap (5m), owner updates (3m each), decision on CI gate and permanent alert thresholds (10m).

postmortem-bot: Calendar invite created: "Follow-up: 08/14 routing incident RCA check" Tue 15:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood/ev/1898765432-followup

jess.ops: I'll draft the CI gate proposal and attach a short risk/cost note before the meeting.
ravi.eng: PR for metric-label fix is in draft, linking in the doc now.
maria.prod: Thanks all. Please mark actions done in the doc as you complete them. I'll prepare an exec blurb once A1-A4 are closed. Ping me if you want to be added to the outreach reviewers. :white_check_mark:
